tagline: Safer Preview pages, and agents that end runs.
subtitle: A certificate warning in the Preview, pages at 100%, and an agent that can end its own run.

cards.title: A warning for a bad certificate
cards.text: A site whose certificate fails shows a warning with Continue anyway, and the page is marked Not secure until the app closes.

cards.title: Pages open at 100%
cards.text: A page opens at 100%, not the app's 120%, and Cmd+0 resets it. New-tab links open in the pane, and a page can go fullscreen.

cards.title: An agent can end its own run
cards.text: A run is dropped when nothing changed, and ended when the person asked for it.

cards.title: Claude Code's folder question
cards.text: When Claude Code asks about adding a new directory, the app answers for the agent's own folders.

also: Linux downloads linked from README and site
The user guide mentions the Linux beta
footer: Linux is a beta. Try it and tell us what breaks.
